title: Endless Edging Part 3 (3. Part Three (F4A))
description: I'm Shibby, you know ? I shouldn't be begging like this… Especially not to you… But fuck, I don't care about that right now... I need it... I want it... Fuuuck… please? Of course you'll take your foot away, just like that, and keep me wanting like this. How'd this happen to me? God, how did I let it happen… I’m Shibby after all! Fuck, you should be the one begging right now… Please?
author: Mistress Shibby
